### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or unmet need is.

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Clinical / Evidence Basis
If this feature involves cycle math, symptom tracking, or health advice, cite the relevant clinical guidelines (ACOG, NICE, WHO, FSRH, NAMS, etc.).

### Privacy & Architecture Impact
CycleSideChick is 100% on-device and zero-telemetry.
- Does this feature require any external network connection? (Must be NO).
- How will the data be stored in local storage (`csc.v1`)?
- Does it require a schema migration?

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
